t: This is the convent of the Tyburn Nuns, formally the Adorers of the Sacred Heart of Jesus of Montmartre, a Benedictine congregation. Adèle Garnier founded it in Paris. French legislation passed in 1901 forced the nuns to find a new Mother House, and two years later they moved to London. The nuns here practise Perpetual Adoration of the Blessed Sacrament. They also keep a shrine to the Catholic martyrs of the English Reformation. The congregation has since opened convents in nine other countries.
